title: Compatibility of pointed-algebra and residue-triple strict henselizations
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring, $K$ a chosen separable closure of $R/\mathfrak m_R$, with its compatible $R$-algebra structure, and $C$ an $R$-algebra satisfying the pointed-algebra colimit predicate [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. There is a point $p$ of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ with prime ideal $\mathfrak m_R$ and an algebra structure making $K$ a separable closure of the scheme residue field $\kappa(p)$. For this structure the residue-triple ring diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] has a universal cocone with vertex $C$, and every composite $R\to B\to C$ along a cocone leg is the original structural map $R\to C$.

source.place: Tag 04GW, triples identified with pointed etale algebras; specialized to the maximal ideal of a local ring

proof.text: Take the closed point p of Spec R. Compose Spec.residueFieldIso with the inverse of the bijective algebra map from R/m to the ideal residue field at m. Transport the K-algebra structure along this explicit ring equivalence. Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv and the unchanged separably closed field K give IsSepClosure. Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv and IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply show that the evaluation composite R to K equals the given structural map.

Give the ring B of a residue triple its R-algebra structure via alpha. Its evaluation map B to K is an algebra map by the triple compatibility and the preceding equality. HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff identifies the etale conditions. Define the comparison functor, and its inverse on hom sets, using the same underlying ring maps and the under-over commutativity equations. For essential surjectivity, apply SpecToEquivOfField to Spec of a pointed-algebra map B to K. It supplies a prime q and residue embedding factoring that map. Apply Spec to compatibility on R and evaluate at the unique point of Spec K to prove q lies above p. The identity ring equivalence, with the two R-algebra structures supplied explicitly, gives an isomorphism to the original object. Obtain an equivalence from fully faithful and essentially surjective; the identity on each ring is a natural diagram isomorphism compatible with alpha.

Extend the universal algebra cocone supplied by IsStrictHenselization along its vertex isomorphism to C, and whisker with the comparison equivalence. Use etaleResidueTriples_filtered_part to obtain filteredness, then IsFiltered.isConnected. The forgetful functor CommAlgCat R to CommRingCat is definitionally commAlgCatEquivUnder.functor followed by Under.forget, which preserves connected colimits. Map the whiskered algebra cocone by this functor and precompose with the inverse diagram isomorphism. Mathlib colimit transport gives a universal ring cocone with vertex C. The diagram isomorphism compatibility and its inverse identities reduce each R-to-C composite to the algebra cocone leg applied to the structural map, hence to algebraMap R C.

lean.statement: theorem IsStrictHenselization.triples_presentation (R K C : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Field K] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] (hC : IsStrictHenselization R K C) : ∃ (p : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)), p.asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∧ ∃ (a : Algebra ((Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).residueField p) K), letI := a IsSepClosure ((Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).residueField p) K ∧ ∃ (ι : etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram (CommRingCat.of R) p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).residueField p) K)) ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj (CommRingCat.of C)), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of C) ι)) ∧ ∀ t, t.α ≫ ι.app t = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C)
